comparison.objective: Install and verify a clamp-on breaker lockout with padlock; candidate commissions and locks a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Place lockout, tighten knob, close lever and thread/latch shackle versus loosen recessed setscrew, tune collar and retighten with bounded torque.
comparison.success_condition: Lockout resists pull and prevents switch-on versus tuned damper stops a carriage twice without bottoming, rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: Both include adjustment plus locking, but one tests safety-device installation while the other tests calibrated dynamic response. No material rubric detail is missing.
